l-m-h1-b0e01a-01.title: Ngaba igama le-x² lisasala nasesixeni?
l-m-h1-b0e01a-01.goal: Hlola ukuba isibakala sokuba isiphumo sokudibanisa seentetho ezimbini enamalungu e-x² naso sinelungu le-x² siyinyaniso rhoqo na, uze ufumane uchaze imeko apho kungeyonyaniso khona (umzekelo ochasayo).
l-m-h1-b0e01a-01.material: Isibakala: Xa udibanisa iintetho ezimbini enamagama amaninzi ezinamalungu e-x², isiphumo sokudibanisa sihlala sinelungu le-x². Fumana ukudibanisa okubonisa ukuba esi sibakala siphosakele.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-01.s.s1.r.a: I-3x² iyasala kwisiphumo sokudibanisa. Ngumzekelo ofanelana nesibakala.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-01.s.s1.r.c: I-2x² iyasala kwisiphumo sokudibanisa. Ngumzekelo ofanelana nesibakala.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-01.s.s1.r.d: I-4x² iyasala kwisiphumo sokudibanisa. Ngumzekelo ofanelana nesibakala.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-01.s.s1.explain: I-x² kunye ne-−x² zidibana zibe yi-0, ngoko isiphumo sokudibanisa 3x+2 asinalo ilungu le-x².
l-m-h1-b0e01a-01.s.s2.model.0: x²+(−x²)=0, ngoko isiphumo sokudibanisa siba yi-3x+2, engenalo ilungu le-x², ngoko ngumzekelo ochasayo.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-01.s.s2.model.1: Amalungu e-x² eentetho ezimbini anemiqondiso eyahlukileyo, ngoko ayanyamalala xa edibaniswa, nto leyo eyenza ibe ngumzekelo ochasayo.

l-m-h1-b0e01a-02.goal: Hlola ukuba isibakala sokuba i-(a+b)² ihlala ilingana ne-a²+b² siyinyaniso rhoqo na, uze ufumane uchaze imeko apho kungeyonyaniso khona (umzekelo ochasayo).

l-m-h1-b0e01a-02.s.s1.explain: Ukuba a=2 no-b=3, ngoko (2+3)²=25 kwaye 2²+3²=13, ngoko ahlukile.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-02.s.s2.model.0: (2+3)²=25 kodwa 2²+3²=13, ngoko amaxabiso amabini ahlukile. Ngumzekelo ochasayo.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-02.s.s2.model.1: Xa elinye inani li-0, macala omabini ayalingana ngenxa yethamsanqa, kodwa nge-2 ne-3 ufumana i-25 ne-13, ezahlukileyo. Ngoko ngumzekelo ochasayo.

l-m-h1-b0e01a-07.s.s2.model.1: Ukuba usasaza i-(x+3)(x+2), ufumana i-x·x, x·2, 3·x, kunye ne-3·2, ngoko ilingana nesiphumo sokudibanisa seziqwenga ezine.
